finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an einem gegebenen Modell einer neuronalen Erkrankung, zum Beispiel Alzheimer, erklären, wie eine Störung neuronaler Strukturen oder Signalprozesse die Funktion des Systems verändert.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can use a supplied model of a neuronal disorder, such as Alzheimer's, to explain how a disturbance of neuronal structures or signalling processes changes the function of the system.

synthesis.synthesizedBy: Codex technical integration of actual sealed A/B science; model version not exposed
synthesis.rationaleDe: Technische Zusammenführung der echten unabhängig versiegelten A-/B-Erstbewertungen des gleichen vollständigen aktuellen bilingualen Ziels, nativer Seite und Quellen-/Bild-/Kontexteingänge. Alle originalen Records, Run-IDs und Campaign-IDs bleiben exakt. Keine neue fachliche Prüfung oder menschliche Freigabe. A: The bilingual descriptions ask for one causal explanation from a supplied neuronal disease model, not classification or diagnosis of all diseases. HE physical43 supports the model principle with Alzheimer/Parkinson examples. BY EA explicitly names MS/Parkinson, so BY support remains partial and does not turn Alzheimer into a BY obligation. Explaining a supplied neuronal alteration through its effect on system function is one model competence. Naming alternative disease examples does not create independently required disease competencies. B: The complete German and English descriptions assess one causal explanation from a supplied neuronal-disorder model. Alzheimer is explicitly an example; this does not require interchangeable disease labels, diagnosis or a complete account of disease causation. The actual page and canonical context agree, including HE/BY applicability and boundary inheritance. The HE physical43 LK source supports a principle-level neuronal-disorder example. BY EA11 provides only a partial structural/signalling component toward its mandatory MS/Parkinson symptoms competence; it does not mandate Alzheimer.
synthesis.rationaleEn: Technical factual synthesis of genuine sealed independent A/B first-pass judgments over identical whole current bilingual goals, native pages and source/image/context inputs. Original records, runs and campaign identifiers are retained exactly. No new scientific review or human approval. A: In the supplied disease model, neural connections and signalling processes support information processing; changing those structures or processes can impair system function. The model relationship does not establish an individual diagnosis. B: A neuronal structure or signalling process disturbed in the supplied model can change system function; the model explains a bounded relationship.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Im gegebenen Krankheitsmodell beeinflussen neuronale Verbindungen und Signalprozesse die Verarbeitung von Information; eine Veränderung dieser Strukturen oder Prozesse kann die Systemfunktion beeinträchtigen. Der Modellzusammenhang begründet keine individuelle Diagnose.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: In the supplied disease model, neural connections and signalling processes support information processing; changing those structures or processes can impair system function. The model relationship does not establish an individual diagnosis.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person begründet, wie die im Material angegebene neuronale Veränderung eine bezeichnete Systemfunktion beeinträchtigt, und trennt diesen Modellbefund von unspezifischen Symptomen und einer Krankheitsdiagnose.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner justifies how the neural change stated in the material impairs a specified system function and distinguishes the model finding from non-specific symptoms and a disease diagnosis.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: In einem neuen Material mit verändertem Struktur- oder Übertragungsprozess erläutert die lernende Person die jeweils passende Wirkung und begründet, weshalb ähnliche Funktionsprobleme weder denselben Mechanismus noch dieselbe Erkrankung beweisen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Given fresh material with a changed structural or transmission process, the learner explains the corresponding effect and justifies why similar impairments prove neither the same mechanism nor the same disease.

dissent.textDe: Die beiden aktuellen keep-Reviews unterscheiden sich in understandingEvidence, rationale, evidenceProfileRecommendation; das Manifest wählt ausdrücklich die Evidence-Fassung der ersten Runde.
dissent.textEn: The two current keep reviews differ in understandingEvidence, rationale, evidenceProfileRecommendation; the manifest explicitly selects the evidence formulation from the first round.
